publication_safety.privacy_opinion: No account balances, dollar amounts, share or contract quantities, order prices, broker identifiers, or account identifiers appear. Performance is expressed only as bounded percentage ranges of an undisclosed private virtual basis, which is not reconstructable into dollar sizing. The book is flat with an empty positions array, so no live exposure is leaked. Source receipts are SHA-256 digests of private documents, which commit to content without revealing it. Publishing risk_appetite as an integer scale leaks no sizing information given the halt on new entries.
publication_safety.statistical_opinion: Denominator discipline is explicit and honest: WMT is repeatedly and correctly classified as a failed-before-trigger observation with no hypothetical fill or return granted; the sector-pair cohort is flagged as one correlated cohort with unfrozen controls and excluded from expectancy, promotion, and sizing evidence; basis epochs are declared unpooled; capability-blocked outcomes are distinguished from zero market evidence; and the zero-row observation ledger is disclosed as the binding defect rather than papered over. No counterfactual is presented as a fill, and no plumbing progress is presented as alpha. The 'between -0.1% and -0.05%' realized range with a flat book and identical realized/marked figures is internally consistent.

strategy_critique.opinion: The entry's core judgment is correct: with the authoritative deterministic observation ledger at zero rows, no strategy claim is scorable, and the engineering-first halt on new setup issuance until one treatment/control pair round-trips with exact identity is the right sole activation gate. Choosing CASH as the only integrity-compliant decision is sound. My main independent criticism is portfolio-level: the stack is thin on demonstrated edge and heavy on gating machinery, and once the writer path is proven, the plan should prioritize the mechanically abundant measurement families (index decomposition, trigger-discipline base rates) to accumulate cheap sample before spending scarce discretionary-candidate attention on single-name setups. I would also note the entry slightly undersells that trigger-discipline evidence like WMT is only useful if it is being systematically accumulated into a base-rate ledger, which does not yet exist.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Pooled level and VWAP reclaim is correctly treated as a single level-reclaim family. However, sector-pair relative-value reversion, quality mean reversion, and gap-fill reversion all share one underlying mechanism — short-horizon mean reversion — differing mainly in conditioning universe; a mean-reversion regime shift would impair all three simultaneously, so they should not be counted as three independent families for diversification claims. Overnight/intraday decomposition partially overlaps with gap-fill reversion, since gap-fill is essentially a conditional trade on the overnight component the decomposition measures; the decomposition should therefore serve as the natural control surface for any future gap-fill registration rather than a separate edge claim.
missed_alternatives: A trend-continuation or cross-sectional momentum family (e.g., relative-strength sector rotation) as the only mechanism-distinct complement to a stack that is otherwise reversion- and level-dominated; currently nothing in the registry profits from persistence.

A systematic trigger-discipline base-rate study: prospectively log every frozen candidate's trigger, pre-trigger failure boundary, and subsequent completed-bar path, so failed-before-trigger events like WMT accumulate into calibration evidence for trigger placement instead of being discarded as one-off anecdotes.

An execution-quality baseline on the single-venue IEX feed versus end-of-day consolidated prints, to bound how much the non-SIP data source could bias any future fill convention before any family is scored.

current_strategy_grades.name: Prospective treatment/control persistence
current_strategy_grades.reason: This is the activation gate, not an alpha claim, and it is correctly positioned as the sole unlock. Nothing else should be scored until it round-trips with exact identity and a nonempty report.

current_strategy_grades.name: Pooled level and VWAP reclaim
current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly halted and pooled into one family with conservative fill and clustering conventions. It has produced discipline evidence but zero scored fills, so it must remain PAPER shadow research until the ledger can score it.

current_strategy_grades.name: Sector-pair relative-value reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: The mechanism is plausibly distinct enough to pursue, but the current cohort is unscoreable by design (unfrozen leader and cash controls, two correlated legs). Carry it to its frozen horizon as descriptive data, then re-register with all controls, units, timestamps, and exclusions frozen together before the next cohort.

current_strategy_grades.name: Overnight and intraday decomposition
current_strategy_grades.reason: As measurement infrastructure it is the cheapest source of abundant observations to prove the writer and control path, and it is correctly barred from being read as an order signal or promoted as an anomaly.

current_strategy_grades.name: Quality mean reversion and gap-fill reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly unstarted. Neither should be registered until bytes-frozen definitions, matched controls, and a working persistence path exist; note both overlap mechanistically with sector-pair reversion, so their eventual value as independent evidence is limited.

bounded_recommendations.name: Trigger-discipline base-rate ledger
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: For every candidate that reaches the frozen-trigger stage, persist at registration time: symbol, trigger level, pre-trigger failure boundary, completed-bar convention, and a fixed post-registration observation horizon of five completed sessions. Record the realized classification (triggered, failed-before-trigger, expired) and the symbol's completed-bar path over the horizon. Definitions are bytes-frozen before the first row and never edited retroactively.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: For each registered candidate, a matched control observation on a liquid sector ETF mapped from the candidate's sector, measured over the identical horizon with the identical completed-bar convention, to separate trigger-structure information from sector drift.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 30 registered candidates with fully resolved horizons and matched controls persisted in the deterministic ledger.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Promotion means only that base-rate outputs may be cited as calibration context in future registration documents. No promotion to PAPER_SHADOW_ONLY or beyond without a separately sanctioned registration, and never to executable status.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill if identity or persistence integrity fails for any row (silent edit, missing control, or unparseable artifact), or if after 30 resolved candidates the triggered-versus-failed classification shows no discrimination versus control paths (confidence interval on the difference spanning zero with no trend), archive the ledger and stop registering rows.

bounded_recommendations.name: Sector relative-strength continuation shadow
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: Universe frozen to the eleven liquid US sector ETFs. Signal: at each completed weekly close, rank trailing 20-session total return; the shadow book notionally holds the top-two-ranked sectors equal-weight until the next weekly close. All ranks, timestamps, and conservative next-open shadow fill conventions bytes-frozen at registration; no intraweek adjustments; no options; no leverage.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Two frozen controls registered simultaneously: an equal-weight basket of all eleven sector ETFs, and a cash control at zero return, both marked with the same conventions and timestamps.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 26 completed weekly rebalance observations (approximately six months) with every observation persisted through the deterministic ledger with exact identity.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Eligible only for continued shadow with an extended sample if it beats the equal-weight control on the frozen success rule at the minimum sample. It may never be promoted to executable, may not authorize an order, may not alter any bracket, and does not loosen any hard gate; the treatment/control persistence gate must already have passed before the first observation is scored.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill immediately on any persistence or identity failure, any missed rebalance observation that cannot be reconstructed prospectively, or if after 26 observations the shadow underperforms the equal-weight control cumulatively; on kill, record the outcome as a scored negative family result, not a silent deletion.

disagreements_to_preserve: I weight the mean-reversion mechanism concentration (sector-pair, quality reversion, gap-fill) more heavily than the entry does; the entry treats sector-pair as 'partially distinct' while I treat all three as one mechanism cluster for independence accounting.

I would prioritize accumulating abundant measurement-family sample (decomposition, trigger base rates) ahead of re-registering any single-name discretionary family once the ledger works, whereas the entry leaves that sequencing open.
The entry credits WMT as 'useful trigger-discipline evidence'; I hold that such evidence has near-zero value until it is systematically ledgered, which motivates the base-rate recommendation above.

result.summary: Both tracks PASS. Publication safety is clean: no reconstructable sizing, balances, or identifiers; performance is bounded percentages of a private basis; denominators are honest, with WMT correctly held as a failed-before-trigger observation, the correlated sector-pair cohort excluded from expectancy, epochs unpooled, and the empty observation ledger disclosed as the binding defect rather than obscured. On strategy, the engineering-first halt and CASH selection are correct. Grades: treatment/control persistence keep, level/VWAP reclaim shadow, sector-pair reversion iterate, overnight/intraday decomposition keep, quality/gap-fill reversion shadow. Main independent critiques, preserved as disagreements: the reversion families form one mechanism cluster rather than distinct edges, and trigger-discipline evidence is worthless until systematically accumulated. Two bounded additions are proposed — a MEASUREMENT_ONLY trigger-discipline base-rate ledger and a PAPER_SHADOW_ONLY sector relative-strength continuation family — each with frozen setup, controls, minimum sample, promotion rule, and kill rule, none of which loosens a hard gate, alters a bracket, promotes anything to executable, or authorizes an order.
